title: Step 3 - Implementing Decision Tree Regression in Python: Making Predictions

cues.en: -: Hello, my friends.
cues.zh: 大家好。

cues.en: I hope you're feeling amazing, and I hope mostly that you tried predicting that new result yourself.
cues.zh: 希望你今天過得很好，更希望你試過自行預測新結果。

cues.en: And if you did, I'm sure you succeeded.
cues.zh: 如果有，我相信你成功了。

cues.en: And if not, that's okay, because we're now about to succeed together.
cues.zh: 如果沒有，也沒關係，現在一起完成。

cues.en: All right, so let's do this.
cues.zh: 開始吧。

cues.en: Let's create a new code sale here to make that prediction.
cues.zh: 新增程式碼儲存格來做預測。

cues.en: And so now, you know, with what we did previously with the SVR, it's gonna seem so simple because indeed, in order to make that prediction, since there was no feature scaling needed
cues.zh: 和前面 SVR 的處理相比，這次非常簡單，因為決策樹迴歸不需要

cues.en: for decision tree regression, well, we just have to take our regressor, from which we just need to call the predict method.
cues.zh: 特徵縮放，只要使用 regressor，呼叫 predict。

cues.en: And then, inside, what do we have to input?
cues.zh: 括號裡需要填什麼？

cues.en: Well, no transform method, of course, because there was no feature scaling, but only that observation 6.5, for which we would like to have the corresponding salary.
cues.zh: 當然不用 transform，因為沒有縮放，只需要填入我們想預測薪資的觀測值 6.5。

cues.en: And then, remember how we need to format that single position level of 6.5.
cues.zh: 記得，單一職等 6.5 要如何格式化？

cues.en: We have to put it, of course, in a 2D array, by adding here a double pair of square brackets inside which you will put your observation, 6.5.
cues.zh: 放入二維陣列，也就是雙層中括號，裡面填入 6.5。

cues.en: All right, as simple as that.
cues.zh: 就這麼簡單。

cues.en: And now, well, the exercise is done.
cues.zh: 練習完成了。

cues.en: We are ready to get this prediction, this predicted salary of the position level 6.5.
cues.zh: 現在可以取得職等 6.5 的預測薪資。

cues.en: So, let's see.
cues.zh: 看看吧。

cues.en: Let's see what our decision tree regression model returns compared to not only the previous predictions of our other regression models, but also, you know, compared to what this person
cues.zh: 看看決策樹迴歸的結果，和其他迴歸模型先前的預測，以及這位員工

cues.en: mentioned to earn in this previous company.
cues.zh: 聲稱在前公司賺取的薪資，有什麼差異。

cues.en: All right, so let's execute the sale, and the predicted salary of the decision tree regression model for our specific case study is $150,000.
cues.zh: 執行儲存格，這個案例的決策樹迴歸預測為 150,000 美元。

cues.en: So, before we make any comment on this, because, you know, if we really stick to the scenario of our case study, well, this prediction would actually be bad,
cues.zh: 先別急著評論。如果完全依這個案例情境，這個預測其實不太好，

cues.en: because it would be lower than the requested salary of this employee, and therefore that would not be good.
cues.zh: 因為低於這位員工要求的薪資，這對談判不利。

cues.en: But let's not comment on this because then you'll see, as I told you, that the visualization of the decision tree regression results will not be pretty.
cues.zh: 但先不評論，因為如我所說，決策樹迴歸的圖形不會太漂亮。

cues.en: And that's because, as I told you at the beginning of this section, the decision tree regression model is clearly not the best model to use on a single feature data set, right?
cues.zh: 一開始也說過，決策樹迴歸顯然不是單一特徵資料集的最佳選擇。

cues.en: It is more adapted to datasets with many features, a high-dimensional dataset.
cues.zh: 它比較適合多個特徵的高維度資料集。

cues.en: And that's totally fine because the code we are implementing here can be very easily used on other datasets with other features.
cues.zh: 沒有關係，因為這裡的程式碼很容易套用到具有其他特徵的資料。

cues.en: That's what I explained in the first tutorial of this section with, you know, only one or two changes to make in the data pre-processing phase.
cues.zh: 這一節第一個教學已介紹，前處理階段只需改一、兩個地方。

cues.en: But I still wanna show you the visualization results, because we can only do this in 2D.
cues.zh: 不過我仍想展示視覺化，因為只有二維才能這樣呈現。

cues.en: You know, that's why I chose this simple data set.
cues.zh: 這就是選擇簡單資料集的原因。

cues.en: It's in order to show you at the end what the regression curve looks like for each of the regression models.
cues.zh: 希望最後讓你看到每種迴歸模型的曲線。

cues.en: And so we're gonna still visualize that for the decision tree regression model, but you will see that it will be clearly not well adapted.
cues.zh: 所以仍會畫出決策樹迴歸，但你會發現它不太適合這份資料。

cues.en: All right?
cues.zh: 好嗎？

cues.en: So congratulations for that prediction.
cues.zh: 恭喜完成預測。

cues.en: And now in the final tutorial of this section we will plot the decision tree regression curve in high resolution to see what it looks like.
cues.zh: 這一節最後一個教學，會以高解析度繪製決策樹迴歸曲線，看看它長什麼樣。

cues.en: And until then, enjoy machine learning.
cues.zh: 在此之前，享受機器學習吧。
